'''''Euphorbia nicaeensis''''' is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Euphorbiaceae]].

==Subspecies==
*''Euphorbia nicaeensis subsp. glareosa'' (Pallas ex Bieb.) A.R. Sm. 
*''Euphorbia nicaeensis subsp. nicaeensis''

==Description==
''Euphorbia nicaeensis'' is a perennial, herbaceous plant or a shrub, reaching a height of about {{convert|20|-|50|cm}}. It has erect, simple, ocher-orange stems, usually leafless and covered with leaf scars on most of its length. Leaves are glaucous gray, narrowly lanceolate, oblong or ovate, about {{convert|10|-|75|mm}} long, arranged in apical rosettes and inflorescences. The flowering period extends from June to August.<ref>[http://flora.uniud.it/scheda.php?id=1633 Flora]</ref><ref name=fa>[http://www.tela-botanica.org/bdtfx-nn-75125-synthese Tela-botanica]</ref>

==Distribution==
This species can be found in southern and eastern Europe (Spain, Portugal, Italy, Croatia), in Turkey, in the Caucasus and in Algeria.<ref name=fa/>
